differentiable.limitations: Local projected Adam penalty optimization, not a proof of global optimality. Discrete manufacturable point is selected by the grid and independently re-solved.
differentiable.model_scope:
fp64 Warp reduced-model design/UQ/Tape kernels. Shared exactly by CUDA and CPU.
Surrogate is PhysicsNeMo trained on independent Warp finite-volume labels, tabulated in a,b.
Panel mass uses exact circular 8/7-mm tube annulus; coolant head stays conservatively inherited.
differentiable.objective: minimum radiator wet mass subject to design temperature goals; panel count, fin length and thickness continuously relaxed; full sweep uses full spacecraft mass

sweep_cross_check.note: Same radiator objective and temperature goals; continuous relaxation may be below discrete grid. The adopted minimum-spacecraft-mass choice may differ.

labels.dimensionless_equation: u_xx=a*(u^4-b^4), a=2*epsilon*sigma*L^2*Tb^3/(k*t), b=Ts/Tb; eta_fin is invariant under the mapped physical geometry

architecture.output: eta_fin residual from tangent-linear fin solution

surrogate.label_source: Native fp64 Warp finite-volume Newton/PCG; held-out labels not used for training
surrogate.limits: Conditional deterministic surrogate, not flight validation. Table spans dimensionless groups; low-a tangent limit. Selected design must be re-solved with native Warp fin table.
